entries.7506d9047b4ce3e3: From the fiscal year ended March 2024, the company has been advancing its medium- to long-term five-year plan “J-VISION 30.” Its two pillars of growth strategy are “Strengthening existing businesses” and “Creating new businesses,” and its vision is “Dreams through technology -Make our dreams by Technology-,” with the aim of becoming a sustainable company that lasts 100 years. It also aims to shift into an electrification supplier focused on electrification and lightweighting.

entries.7db5d5ecac17bf42: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the third year of the plan, the Okayama plant in Japan and a new site in Fujian Province, China began operations, and production of electrification components for in-vehicle battery makers increased in China.
